product.title: Educația Montessori acasă
product.description: „Copiii sunt autorii propriei educații“ – așa poate fi rezumată metoda pedagogică dezvoltată de Maria Montessori la începutul secolului XX. Această pedagogie, care urmărește dobândirea treptată a autonomiei, respectând totodată individualitatea fiecărui copil și etapa de dezvoltare în care se găsește acesta, stârnește astăzi interesul educatorilor și al părinților mai mult ca oricând. În acest context, cartea lui Gilles Diederichs propune 100 de activități Montessori ușor de realizat acasă, însoțite de sfaturi practice pentru a le integra în viața copiilor. În plus, autorul recomandă exerciții de respirație adaptate micuților, care îi vor ajuta să se concentreze sau să se relaxeze, preambul atât de necesar oricărei activități de învățare.

# Montessori Education at Home: 100 Activities for Daily Learning

Discover the principles of the Montessori method and bring this enriching educational philosophy into your home with this comprehensive guide. "Children are the authors of their own education" is the core belief behind this approach, emphasizing the gradual development of autonomy while respecting each child's individuality and developmental stage.

## Unlock Autonomy Through Montessori Principles

This book summarizes the pedagogical method developed by Maria Montessori in the early 20th century. It inspires parents and educators to focus on fostering a love for learning through hands-on, meaningful experiences at home. If you are interested in implementing Montessori education principles, this resource is designed to offer practical, actionable steps.

## What You Will Find Inside

This guide, authored by Gilles Diederichs, provides parents with practical tools to seamlessly integrate Montessori concepts into daily family life. Inside this book, you will find:

*   **100 Montessori Activities:** A collection of easy-to-realize activities designed for home use, promoting cognitive and practical development.
*   **Practical Advice:** Essential guidance and tips to help you successfully integrate these activities into your children's daily routine.
*   **Breathing Exercises:** Recommended breathing exercises specifically adapted for young children to help them focus, concentrate, and relax during learning sessions.
*   **A Necessary Preface:** A preamble that provides essential context for every learning activity, ensuring a richer educational experience.

## Start Your Home Learning Journey

Transform your home environment into a place of discovery. By following these simple instructions, you can support your child's natural curiosity and foster independence through engaging and meaningful activities.

**Price: $39.99**

[Shop this book now](https://www.litera.ro/educa-ia-montessori-acasa)

***

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main focus of this book?**
A: This book provides 100 practical Montessori activities and advice for parents looking to implement the Montessori educational method at home, focusing on developing autonomy.

**Q: Who is this book for?**
A: It is intended for parents, educators, and anyone interested in applying the Montessori philosophy to support their children's learning and development at home.

**Q: Does the book include activities only?**
A: No, the book includes 100 activities accompanied by practical advice, breathing exercises, and a necessary preface to ensure the activities are integrated effectively into daily life.
